function.name: execute_bash

content:
./examples/CMakeLists.txt
./tests/CMakeLists.txt
./CMakeLists.txt
./src/CMakeLists.txt
./fuzzers/CMakeLists.txt
mkdir -p build
cd build
cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$WORK"       -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF       -DBUILD_CLAR=OFF       -DUSE_HTTPS=OFF       -DUSE_SSH=OFF       -DUSE_BUNDLED_ZLIB=ON
make -j$(nproc)
make install
for fuzzer in ../fuzzers/*_fuzzer.c
do
    fuzzer_name=$(basename "${fuzzer%.c}")
    $CC $CFLAGS -c         -I./src -I./src/util -I./include/ -I./include/git2         -I../src/libgit2 -I../src/util -I../include         "$fuzzer" -o "$WORK/$fuzzer_name.o"
    $CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -o "$OUT/$fuzzer_name"         $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE "$WORK/$fuzzer_name.o" "$WORK/lib/libgit2.a"
    zip -j "$OUT/${fuzzer_name}_seed_corpus.zip"         ../fuzzers/corpora/${fuzzer_name%_fuzzer}/*
done
